Model structures to compare

Source: R/structures.R
structure_set.Rd

A named list of configurations for compare_structures(), each one change from a base structure, so that each comparison answers one question: does a different soil store, recharge rule or groundwater store fit this catchment better?

Usage

structure_set(names = NULL, base = pdm_presets("standard"))

Arguments

names

Structures to include; by default all eight.

base

Configuration whose area, time step, delay, rainfall factor and other settings carry over. Its components are not used: every structure starts from the standard PDM's components, so each name means the same structure whatever the base.

Value

A named list of configuration lists.

Details

NameChange from the base
standardNone: Pareto store, standard recharge, cascade surface, cubic groundwater
rectangular, triangular, exponential, lognormalSoil capacity distribution
splitSplit recharge
demandDemand recharge
exponential_groundwaterExponential groundwater store

Pick a subset by name, or add your own configurations to the list; any combination is allowed if you have a reason to test it.

Examples

names(structure_set())
#> [1] "standard"                "rectangular"            
#> [3] "triangular"              "exponential"            
#> [5] "lognormal"               "split"                  
#> [7] "demand"                  "exponential_groundwater"
structure_set(c("standard", "lognormal"))$lognormal$distribution
#> $type
#> [1] "lognormal"
#> 
#> $meanlog
#> [1] 4.1
#> 
#> $sdlog
#> [1] 0.8
#>
